purpose: Classify organ-local memory so local stores digest and compress information without becoming hidden organism-wide sources of truth.

central_memory.local_memory_role: perception buffer, cache, outbox, warehouse, reports, and crash recovery for a single organ

storage_classes.raw: Append-only local perception: command output, provider evidence, sensor samples.
storage_classes.normalized: Validated local events in stable organ schema.
storage_classes.warehouse: Queryable local history for trends, compression, and replay.
storage_classes.ccm: Compressed cognition memory: distilled observations/proofs ready for Kernel promotion.
storage_classes.outbox: Durable local queue for idempotent Kernel delivery when central storage is unavailable.
storage_classes.deadletter: Events that failed validation or delivery and need human/organ remediation.
storage_classes.cache: Regenerable materialized view or temporary computed state.
storage_classes.artifact: Heavy proof material, logs, reports, dashboards, or build output references.
storage_classes.checkpoint: Cursor, watermark, last-seen id, or sync position.
storage_classes.local_journal: Append-only organ-local audit used for crash recovery and replay.
storage_classes.local_snapshot: Point-in-time state view scoped to one organ.
storage_classes.desired_projection: Organ-local projection of desired state; not the canonical desired state.
storage_classes.local_contract: Schema or policy used by the local organ runtime.
storage_classes.operator_view: Human-readable or browser-rendered local view derived from state.
storage_classes.local_doc: Local state documentation or skill instruction.

authority_levels.local_only: Useful to one organ; cannot decide organism truth.
authority_levels.kernel_promotion_candidate: May be compressed and pushed to Kernel with idempotent read-back.
authority_levels.derived_from_git_or_kernel: Projection/cache derived from canonical state elsewhere.
authority_levels.legacy_debt: Tracked historical state that must be migrated, ignored, or removed.

local_backend_policy.jsonl: Preferred for append-only raw/journal/report streams and simple replay.
local_backend_policy.sqlite: Preferred for autonomous organs that need indexes, transactions, retries, outbox, and crash-safe reconciliation.
local_backend_policy.json: Allowed for snapshots, checkpoints, local projections, and small cache files.
local_backend_policy.html: Allowed only for derived operator views.
local_backend_policy.pac: Allowed only for local runtime artifacts or generated network policy views.

promotion_rules: raw local data is not promoted directly unless a controller explicitly chooses it as proof evidence
ccm and outbox events promoted to Kernel must include source_organ, event_type, payload_hash, idempotency_key, and observed_at
task dispatches and critical observations require read-back before the organ may claim durable memory
local SQLite/JSONL stores must tolerate Kernel or SurrealDB downtime and flush later without duplicate events
organs/*/state and infra/organ-anvil must not claim organism_canonical authority
